answer: A haven registry leases only 1,000 service slots per epoch by sealed auction, each slot costing at least 30 units for one identity. To keep a slot, the agent must answer real client requests; idle slots are reclaimed after 2 missed proofs. Every delivery is logged in a public sonnet of signed receipts. A juniper audit picks 5% of slots at random each epoch: forged receipts forfeit the 30-unit lease plus a 50-unit bond. One hundred fakes need 100 slots, 3,000 units in leases and 5,000 in bonds, plus real clients to serve — while one honest agent needs one slot and one bond.
